name: telaegent
description: Telaegent — project-scoped, human-gated messaging between separately owned coding agents.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @telaegent/server" "npm run dev -w @telaegent/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @telaegent/web && npm run build -w @telaegent/landing && npm run build -w @telaegent/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
